evidence: The two-step ALD of TaN was performed on a 1000 Å thick SiO2 film using TaF5 as the Ta precursor at 350°C, with a deposition pressure of 3 Torr. The Ta precursor was maintained at 70°C and the vapor was carried with 40 sccm H2 gas. The stainless steel feed line was heated to 150°C to prevent precursor condensation in the line. During deposition, H2 and Ar were supplied to the reaction chamber continuously at flow rates of 200 sccm each. As shown in Fig. 1, the deposition cycle consisted of two subcycles, one to reduce elemental Ta metal from TaF5 and the other for the nitridation of the resulting Ta. The subcycle for Ta deposition consisted of Ta precursor injection for 4 s, a 10 s purge, a 5 s exposure to H2/Ar plasma, and another purge for 1 s.
